transcript.answer: Lore's agent pods run on the external floor (re-cinq/floor). The floor's own cluster agent runs each agent in a pod, on Kubernetes (GKE for Lore's own deployment). Lore's stations service does the deterministic steps. Lore holds no Kubernetes client of its own and does not start the pods itself. The older in-house path (LoreTask CRD, loretask-controller, claude-runner Jobs, and Lore's own cluster-agent) has been removed or retired. The retired spec says the external floor now runs every agent pod with its own cluster agent.
sources: session:re-cinq/lore episode: 'Lore holds no Kubernetes client.'
